query: For my 66-year-old female, among women 61–71 admitted with primary heart failure, what is the average hospital length of stay?
final_sql: SELECT AVG(icustays.los) AS average_length_of_stay FROM patients JOIN admissions ON patients.subject_id = admissions.subject_id JOIN icustays ON admissions.stay_id = icustays.stay_id WHERE patients.gender = 'F' AND patients.anchor_year = 66 AND admissions.admission_type = 'primary heart failure' AND patients.anchor_year_group BETWEEN 61 AND 71;
